events.text: Goal! Brentford 1, Tottenham Hotspur 0. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Mamadou Sangaré.
Goal! Brentford 2, Tottenham Hotspur 0. Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Conor Gallagher (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Mateus Fernandes replaces Conor Gallagher.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Rodrigo Bentancur replaces Lucas Bergvall.
Goal! Brentford 3, Tottenham Hotspur 0. Michael Kayode (Brentford) right footed shot from very close range to the top right corner following a corner.
Penalty missed! Still Brentford 3, Tottenham Hotspur 0. Igor Thiago (Brentford) hits the left post with a right footed shot.
Substitution, Brentford. Yehor Yarmoliuk replaces Mathias Jensen.
Substitution, Brentford. Jaidon Anthony replaces Dango Ouattara.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. James Maddison replaces Mikey Moore.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Dominic Solanke replaces Richarlison.
Substitution, Brentford. Mikkel Damsgaard replaces Mamadou Sangaré.
Substitution, Brentford. Aaron Hickey replaces Michael Kayode.
Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Brentford. Callum Wilson replaces Igor Thiago.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Destiny Udogie replaces Archie Gray.
Second Half ends, Brentford 3, Tottenham Hotspur 0.
